name: refiner_v1_ma_he_candidate
_comment: FROZEN CONFIG for the MA/HE candidate patch refiner. Every value here is
declared before training and must not be re-tuned on val. The candidate
rule was chosen by the pre-declared GO/NO-GO criterion written in
GO_NO_GO.md section 3; the full audit grid is reported in
audit/candidate_audit.json so the choice can be checked mechanically.
Nothing in this file may be edited after the first training run starts.

task.objective: refine frozen-champion MA/HE probabilities inside candidate patches

_selection_rule: Pre-declared: among the audited grid, take the rule with the SMALLEST
mean candidate area whose MA and HE GT-pixel recall upper bounds both
clear the gate (MA>=0.85, HE>=0.90) by at least +0.01 absolute margin.
t=0.20,d=0 is smaller (0.0393 of pixels) but its HE margin is only
+0.0083, so it is excluded by the margin requirement. t=0.10,d=0 is the
next smallest and is frozen here.
Scanning any further threshold on val is forbidden from this point on.

cache.layout: ragged (natural patch size, no padding); offsets rebuilt from `shape`
_layout_note: The first prototype padded every patch in an image to the largest
window (640x640) and cost 3.67 MB/image. Storing ragged removes that
waste and also stops zero padding from entering normalisation statistics.
_sampling_note: Sampling ratio per image = ALL candidate tiles : 2 empty background tiles.
Measured on val: 21.04 candidate tiles/image. The four training-relevant
plain candidate background, non-candidate background) are NOT resampled
separately -- they occur naturally inside the candidate tiles and their
measured fractions are recorded per split in the cache index.
Constraint: dropping candidate tiles would silently lower the audited
candidate recall upper bound, so no cap is applied.

model.head: conv1x1 48->2 (zero-initialised)
_residual_scale_reason: Inside a candidate, champion p > t = 0.10, so a bound of 0.5 is always
enough to move that pixel across the 0.5 decision boundary in either
direction, while capping the perturbation at half a probability unit.
Zero-init + tanh(0)=0 gives bitwise identity to the champion at step 0.

_weight_decision: ONE-TIME decision taken by the main agent BEFORE the first formal step,
closing risk R1 of GO_NO_GO.md. In the 40-step learning smoke the focal
term contributed only ~0.5% of the total loss at w_focal=1.0, i.e. the
objective was effectively Dice-only and the hard-example role of focal
was never exercised. Multiplying focal by 30 makes it a visible but
still non-dominant part of the early objective.
This value must NOT be changed afterwards, and must NEVER be chosen or
revised by looking at val (or test) curves. It is mirrored in
assert_frozen_objective fails closed if the three ever disagree, and

dice.form: soft dice, per-class, mean over the 2 classes

loss.ignore: valid==0 pixels (padding and anything outside the patch) contribute 0
_why_only_two_terms: focal_bce is the classification term: MA is 1.7% of pixels in val and the
candidate patches are dominated by negatives, so a hard-example-focused
loss is required; alpha=0.75 supplies the class balance.
soft_dice is the region term and is directly aligned with the reported
Additional losses from the source papers were deliberately NOT summed in:
the round decision explicitly forbids stacking unvalidated modules or
multi-paper loss piles. This is the only two-term objective.

optim._amp_note: AMP off for stage 1 so every number is reproducible in fp32.

stage1_overfit.purpose: sanity: prove model+loss can overfit a handful of patches
stage1_overfit.expect: focal and dice collapse toward 0 on the overfit subset

stage2_main.purpose: main candidate run, val-only model selection
stage2_main.select_on: val MA IoU and HE IoU of the ASSEMBLED full-image map
stage2_main.select_rule: accept only if val MA IoU AND val HE IoU both improve; no per-class threshold tuning

_validation_nodes_note: `checkpoint_nodes` is the pre-registered list of validation nodes. It is
declared here (and mirrored in configs/stage1.json / stage2.json, checked
by a unit test) before the first formal epoch. 30 epochs with a node every
5 gives 6 val evaluations, exactly as budgeted in GO_NO_GO.md R8. The
trainer writes nodes/node_ep###.pth for these epochs and keeps epoch
checkpoints with a bounded retention window; the supervisor evaluates
every node with the fixed p>0.5 rule and nothing else.
No node may be added, removed or re-weighted after training starts.

inference.write_back: only inside candidate tiles; fixed Hann-weighted average on overlap
inference.EX_SE: bitwise champion (never produced by the refiner)
